## Enhancing YouTube Data Donations With Platform Metadata

**Status:** Public method demonstration

This project demonstrates how donated YouTube account data can be linked with video- and channel-level platform metadata to create enriched exposure histories. Using synthetic mock data, the workflow shows how researchers can move from Google Takeout-style watch, search, and subscription files to event-level indicators of YouTube use.

The demonstration covers cleaning donated histories, extracting and joining YouTube video IDs, adding video and channel metadata, estimating watch time, identifying Shorts and Longs, distinguishing search- and subscription-linked watches, and flagging availability or potentially problematic-content signals.

The project is intended for researchers working with data donation, platform accountability, journalism studies, media-use research, and computational social science.
